substitutions.pattern: "Use only when the user explicitly asks for TDD, a failing test, or a regression test, OR when the bug has an obvious cheap local test target. Skip when the test path is unclear, expensive, integration-heavy, or not requested."
substitutions.replacement: "TDD workflow for bug fixes: write one focused failing regression test before changing production code, when the bug has a clear, cheap local test target. Skip when the test path is unclear, expensive, or integration-heavy. Run it with /tdd, or when asked for TDD, a failing test, or a regression test."

substitutions.pattern: TypeScript best practices. Use when reading or editing any .ts or .tsx file.
substitutions.replacement: TypeScript best practices grounded in type-system discipline. Applies to .ts and .tsx files; run it with /typescript-best-practices.

substitutions.pattern: Use when you run a benchmark or report a speedup or regression you measured.
substitutions.replacement: Run it with /benchmark-checklist before you report a speedup or regression you measured.
